entries.reason: AI model in Settings: the row and the AI model page read defaultProvider from GET /ai-tools/status (the default model and which accounts count as logged in); an older server sends none, so the row cannot say which provider chats run on.

provider failure cards in chats: their Switch, Continue and Retry buttons call POST /ai-tools/provider-failures/:messageId/switch and /continue; an older server has no such routes and writes no provider_failure or provider_outage parts.
